prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1114; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents our client in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving the insured vehicle under your policy. Our client sustained injuries in the accident and is now pursuing a claim for the losses resulting from it. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Kindly provide a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy covering the insured vehicle, along with confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including vehicle data, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, and any repair or inspection records. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm in writing that these preservation requests will be honored. We look forward to your prompt response.
